what: Package unzipped into an empty directory; inputs downloaded fresh (S3, GitHub, EBI, arXiv, AbstractAtlas); pipeline rerun with uv --frozen.

steps_run: rebuild.sh STEPS=all through scope.py (33 min: cohorts, papers, both analysts v1 and v2, reviews, revision flag and compare, graph v1/final, PyNIDM csv2nidm, ReproNim simple2, LinkML validation, resources, UMAP, scope); after the fix below, STEPS=graph through competency; then profile_simple2, validate, find_resources --examples, figures, key_numbers, report.

code_identity: Code in the clean room equals the zip's code. Files changed after the rebuild started (report.py, key_numbers.py, competency/query_bench/profile docstrings, package.py, rebuild.sh, orcd sbatch) only remove the engine comparison or change text; key_numbers and report were rerun in the clean room with them.
reproducibility_bug_caught: code/publications.py fetched the AbstractAtlas bundle with urllib's default User-Agent; the host returns HTTP 403 to 'Python-urllib/3.x' (curl gets 200), so a fresh rebuild failed. Fixed by sending an explicit User-Agent; the bytes are still checked against the sha256 in the URL.
stale_output_caught: graph/abide_extension.ttl in the working package predated the current graph (12 classes); the clean room produced 13 (adds ex:ReportedCohort). Local outputs were regenerated before packaging.
